faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for the owner or custodian of any dog to fail to cause the dog
               to wear a current license tag affixed to the dog's collar, chain, or harness. When
               the dog is wearing a current dog license affixed to its collar, chain, or harness,
               it is not necessary to display a current rabies tag.
(b)
It shall be unlawful for the owner or custodian of any cat to fail to cause the cat
               to wear an identification tag affixed to the cat's collar or harness, or to have an
               identification microchip surgically implanted into the cat, or to wear some other
               similar type of identification. Such tag or microchip shall clearly set forth the
               current owner's name, address, and telephone number.
(
Ord. No. 4060, § 2, 3-19-2007
)
